claims.text: Aggressive B-cell lymphoma (eg, DLBCL): strd = R-CHOP (rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisone).
claims.quote: In patients with aggressive B-cell lymphomas (eg, diffuse large B cell), the standard combination is rituximab plus cyclophosphamide, hydroxydaunorubicin (doxorubicin), vincristine, and prednisone (R-CHOP)
